About the KC Family Bike Ride group ride

KC Family Bike Ride is a social group ride in Kansas City, MO. Schedule: Sunday mornings on the Trolley Track Trail. Time is posted on Instagram, from Trolley Track Trail, Brookside.

A Sunday morning ride for families on the Trolley Track Trail in Brookside. Kids welcome. BikeWalkKC lists it on its Women Bike KC resources page. Check Instagram for the time.

I do the miles. You decide who they’re for.
